# Train AI

Train AI is an AI learning and development platform for organisations.

Canonical website: https://trainailtd.com/
Contact: info@trainailtd.com

## What Train AI does

- Helps organisations deliver and manage courses.
- Supports cohort, learner, instructor and learning community management.
- Provides AI-assisted learning support.
- Helps organisations track progress, skill gaps, readiness and development outcomes.

## Who Train AI serves

- Academies and training providers.
- Foundations and social-impact organisations.
- Businesses managing workforce learning and development.
